transfer.exportIntro: How do you want to take your subscriptions with you?
transfer.importIntro: Where are your subscriptions coming from?
transfer.fileExport: Save them as a JSON file: a backup, or a copy to open on another device.
transfer.fileImport: Open a JSON file exported from the app.

transfer.qrAlt: QR code with a link to your subscriptions
transfer.scanHow: On the other device, open “Export the data” and pick the QR code, then scan it with this device's camera and open the link.
transfer.confirmNew: The link brings {{value}} subscriptions to this device.
transfer.confirmReplace: The link brings {{value}} subscriptions. They replace the ones on this device now.

transfer.invalidLink: This link doesn't contain subscriptions data.
transfer.tooMany: It has more than {{value}} subscriptions, the most the app can keep.
transfer.qrFailed: The QR code couldn't be made. Check your connection, or export a file instead.

install.title: Get the app

scenes.nibble: Subscriptions nibble at your wallet, a little every month.
scenes.add: Add each one: what it is, how much, and how often it renews.
scenes.totals: The totals add up by themselves: per month, and the honest yearly figure.
scenes.due: Renewing this month? The card glows, so nothing catches you off guard.
scenes.inactive: Not using one? Mark it inactive and it stops counting.
scenes.local: Everything stays on your device. Export a backup whenever you like.

tui.exportMessage: Save a copy of your subscriptions as a JSON file.
tui.importMessage: Replace your subscriptions with the ones in a JSON file exported from the app.
tui.invalidPrice: Enter a price of 0 or more, with up to two decimals
tui.invalidDate: Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD
tui.linkMessage: Paste a link made by the app's QR code. It replaces your subscriptions with the ones it carries.
tui.qrTooSmall: Make the terminal at least {{value}} to show the code.
